question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

People of the same ________ are not allowed to get married in her country.
solution:
The correct answer is '**clan**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**clan**'.
 
• It means 'a group of families who are related to each other'. (परस्‍पर संबंधित परिवारों का समुदाय; गोत्र, कुल, वंश)
 
 
• *Example: The tribe is divided into **clans**.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **clam**: a type of shellfish that can be eaten. (एक प्रकार की खाने योग्‍य शंखमीन)
 
• **clot**: a lump formed by blood as it dries. (ख़ून का थक्‍का)
 
• **clum**: Silence; hush. (मौन; चुप रहना)
 
 
 
• Thus, as per the above definition, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__*** People of the same **clan** are not allowed to get married in her country.*

The correct answer is '**silence**'.
